steps.en: Start from a framework, or add React to an existing bundler project
steps.zh: 用框架起一个项目，或者给已有的打包项目加上 React
steps.code: npx create-next-app@latest · npm install react react-dom

steps.en: Write components as functions that return JSX for the current state
steps.zh: 把界面写成函数组件，按当前状态返回 JSX

steps.en: Mount the root component into one DOM element
steps.zh: 把根组件挂到页面上的一个 DOM 元素里

steps.en: Calls your components and builds the DOM they describe
steps.zh: 调用你的组件，生成它们描述的 DOM

steps.en: On each state change, re-runs affected components and diffs the new output against the old
steps.zh: 每次状态变化，重跑受影响的组件，把新结果和旧结果比对

steps.en: Applies only the DOM changes the diff found, keeping focus, scroll and input intact
steps.zh: 只把比对出的差异写进 DOM，焦点、滚动和输入框内容都保住

value.en: You describe what the screen looks like for each state; you never hand-write the DOM updates between states
value.zh: 你只描述每种状态下界面长什么样，状态之间的 DOM 增删改不用再手写
